Are you a full blown production company or a DIY hobbyist? Or somewhere in between?

We run a 5200 square foot shop with a single 8 color automatic and a single 6 color manual. We also offer embroidery and large format printing, so that's in the mix too. My friends are buying cars and boats, and I just bought a new rotary screw compressor...BUT I enjoy it as much as they enjoy the new boat...or at least that's what we'll say! I love the "process" of business building and growth. Each new item is almost like an "achievement" of sorts.

We have the structure and processes of a business with the passion of a DIY shop. Though it may not be a popular or accepted opinion, I feel like we've been very blessed over the past few years. Things were rough for a long time before we finally started to see good things. If there were no passion, we would have closed after the first two or three years. We were not well capitalized, so growth has been an uphill battle. We currently hold no debt and we pay cash for everything, and that alone eliminates a lot of stress.
